column1: # OCM CLI versions this repository's tests are validated against, one row per version.
# test/run.sh reads the expected version-specific behaviour from the row matching
# `ocm version`. On a version without a row, the version-specific tests SKIP and the
# To validate a new OCM release, see docs/development.md#ocm-version-validation.
#   version              OCM CLI version as printed by `ocm version` (no leading v)
#   default_norm         normalisation algorithm of new signatures and reference digests
#   v1_sign_rejection    text in the error of `ocm sign cv --normalisation jsonNormalisation/v1`
#   git_tree_mismatch    `scripts/git.sh download` reason for a commit with a different tree
#   tsa_label_transfer   `ocm transfer cv` of a TSA-timestamped GPG component: ok or fail
